name: opendexter
description: Discover x402 APIs, inspect current terms, view a session-bound Dexter portfolio, and execute only explicitly bounded calls.

interface.shortDescription: Passkey wallet and safely bounded x402 API calls.
interface.longDescription:
OpenDexter connects the assistant to the hosted x402 marketplace and a passkey-controlled Dexter Wallet on Solana. It can search without paying, inspect current endpoint terms, view the exact governed portfolio bound to the authenticated session, and execute a paid call only after the user approves its request and maximum charge.

The hosted contract has eleven tools. Discovery, price checks, wallet-proof access, wallet status, portfolio reads, passkey compatibility, and reusable-skill workflows remain distinct from payment. The older card-tool roster is not part of this package; card controls remain on Dexter's secure wallet surface.

Protected tools use the MCP server's native OAuth contract. Wallet keys, passkey material, bearer tokens, one-time codes, and other authentication secrets never belong in the conversation. Ambiguous or post-dispatch payment results are never retried automatically.
